titulo: On the one hand, on the other
intro: The words that give a long answer or a text a visible shape.
b1.texto:
At B2 the reader should see how your ideas are arranged.

- to begin: **para empezar**, **en primer lugar**
- to go on: **en segundo lugar**, **a continuación**, **por último**
- to weigh two sides: **por un lado… por otro (lado)**; **por una parte… por otra**
- to add: **además**, **asimismo**, **también**, **incluso**; in conversation, **encima**
- to change topic: **en cuanto a**, **respecto a**, **en lo que se refiere a**
- to underline: **cabe destacar que**, **hay que tener en cuenta que**, **lo cierto es que**
- to close: **en resumen**, **en conclusión**, **en definitiva**, **para terminar**

A connector at the start of a sentence is followed by a comma.
b3.f0: Firstly, working from home saves time and money.
b3.f1: On the one hand, it lets you organise your day better.
b3.f2: On the other, many people feel lonely at home.
b3.f3: Moreover, it is hard to separate work from personal life.
b3.f4: As for companies, it is worth noting that they spend less on offices.
b3.f5: All in all, it has advantages, but it is not for everyone.
b5.pregunta: Which connector opens the second side of an argument?
b5.o1.refuerzo: Además adds a point on the same side.
b7.pregunta: Complete: as for companies, they spend less.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Además is not followed by a noun like this.
b7.o2.refuerzo: Incluso las empresas would mean even companies.
b8.o0: Even the bosses prefer to work at home.
b8.o1: Only the bosses prefer to work at home.
b8.o2: The bosses include working at home.
b8.o2.explicacion: Incluso here is the adverb even.
b9.pregunta: Which is the most formal way to add a point?
b10.traduccion: On the one hand, it lets you organise your day better.
b11.texto:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write an opinion essay on whether cities should ban cars from the centre: introduction, arguments on both sides and a conclusion.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Give a structured three-minute talk on the same subject, announcing your points and linking them clearly.
b8.o0.explicacion: Incluso means even, so the sentence says even the bosses prefer working at home.
